ScrollingFrame is a special Frame type with built-in scrolling interactivity and different ways to customize how the scrolling works.

descriptions.before: The size in offsets of the area that is scrollable.
descriptions.after: The size of the area that is scrollable, in offsets.

descriptions.before: The size in offsets of the frame, without the scrollbars.
descriptions.after: The size of the frame, in offsets, without the scroll bars.

descriptions.before: The Down image on the vertical scrollbar. Size of this is always ScrollBarThickness by ScrollBarThickness. This is also used as the image on the horizontal scroll bar.
descriptions.after: Image that displays on the bottom of a vertical scroll bar, or the right of a horizontal scroll bar (rotated 90° counterclockwise for a horizontal scroll bar).

descriptions.before: The location within the canvas, in offsets, that should be drawn at the top left of the scroll frame.
descriptions.after: Reflects the current positional offset of the canvas within the frame, in pixels, and sets the position of scroll bars accordingly.

descriptions.before: Determines the size of the area that is scrollable. The UDim2 is calculated using the parent gui's size, similar to the regular Size property on gui objects.
descriptions.after: Determines the size of the scrollable area.

descriptions.before: Determines when elastic scrolling is allowed.
descriptions.after: Determines if and when elastic scrolling is allowed on touch‑enabled devices.

descriptions.before: Indicates the inset behavior of the horizontal scrolling bar.
descriptions.after: Indicates whether CanvasSize is inset by ScrollBarThickness on the horizontal axis.

descriptions.before: The middle image on the vertical scrollbar. The size of this can vary in the y direction, but is always set as ScrollingFrame.ScrollBarThickness in the x direction. This is also used as the middle image on the horizontal scroll bar.
descriptions.after: Image which spans the area between TopImage and BottomImage (rotated 90° counterclockwise for a horizontal scroll bar).

descriptions.before: Determines how a rendered scroll bar image will be colorized.
descriptions.after: Determines how the rendered scroll bar images are colorized.

descriptions.before: Determines the transparency of the rendered scroll bar image.
descriptions.after: Determines the opacity of the scroll bar images.

descriptions.before: How thick the scroll bar appears. This applies to both the horizontal and vertical scroll bars. If set to 0, no scroll bars are rendered.
descriptions.after: Thickness of the scroll bar in pixels; applies to both horizontal and vertical scroll bars.

descriptions.before: Determines the direction scrolling is allowed in this scrolling frame.
descriptions.after: Determines the direction(s) in which scrolling is allowed.

descriptions.before: Determines whether or not scrolling is allowed on the frame. If false, no scroll bars will be rendered.
descriptions.after: Determines whether scrolling is allowed on the frame.

descriptions.before: The Up image on the vertical scrollbar. The size of this is always ScrollBarThickness by ScrollBarThickness. This is also used as the left image on the horizontal scroll bar.
descriptions.after: Image which displays on the top of a vertical scroll bar, or the left of a horizontal scroll bar (rotated 90° counterclockwise for a horizontal scroll bar).

descriptions.before: Indicates the inset behavior of the vertical scrolling bar.
descriptions.after: Indicates whether CanvasSize is inset by ScrollBarThickness on the vertical axis.

descriptions.before: Indicates the side that the vertical scrollbar will be located at.
descriptions.after: Indicates whether the vertical scroll bar is positioned to the left or right of the canvas.

descriptions.before: GuiObject that can display children 3D objects.
descriptions.after: GuiObject that renders 3D objects inside its bounds.

descriptions.before: Determines how a rendered image will be colorized.
descriptions.after: Determines how the rendered viewport image will be colorized.

descriptions.before: Determines the transparency of the rendered image.
descriptions.after: Determines the transparency of the rendered viewport image.

descriptions.after: Provides haptic feedback to controllers and devices.

descriptions.before: Returns the current vibration value set to the specified UserInputType and VibrationMotor. This will not return anything if SetMotor has not been called prior.
descriptions.after: Returns the current vibration value set to the specified UserInputType and VibrationMotor.

descriptions.before: The current vibration value set to the specified UserInputType and VibrationMotor or nil if SetMotor has not been called prior.
descriptions.after: The current vibration value set to the specified UserInputType and VibrationMotor or nil if SetMotor() has not been called prior.

descriptions.before: Returns true if the specified motor is available to be used with the specified UserInputType.
descriptions.after: Returns true if the specified motor is available to be used with the specified UserInputType.

descriptions.before: True if the specified motor is available to be used with the specified UserInputType, false if not.
descriptions.after: Boolean of true if the specified motor is available to be used with the specified UserInputType, false if not.

descriptions.before: Returns true if the specified UserInputType supports haptic feedback.
descriptions.after: Returns true if the specified UserInputType supports haptic feedback.

descriptions.before: True if the specified UserInputType supports haptic feedback.
descriptions.after: Boolean of true if the specified UserInputType supports haptic feedback.

descriptions.after: Returns policy information about a player based on geolocation, age group, and platform.

descriptions.before: This enum is used by ScrollingFrame.ElasticBehavior to specifies how elastic scrolling behaves for a ScrollingFrame.
descriptions.after: This enum is used by ScrollingFrame.ElasticBehavior to control when elastic scrolling is active on touch‑enabled devices.

descriptions.before: The scrollbar will be elastic when there is content to be scrolled to.
descriptions.after: Scrolling is elastic when there is content to be scrolled to.

descriptions.before: The scrollbar will always have elastic scrolling available, even when there isn't content available to scroll to.
descriptions.after: Scrolling is always elastic, even when there isn't content available to scroll to.

descriptions.before: The scrollbar will never have elastic scrolling available.
descriptions.after: Scrolling is never elastic and the canvas will never scroll beyond its bounds.

descriptions.before: Indicates when the ScrollingFrame should be insetted by the space needed to show the scroll bar.
descriptions.after: This enum is used with ScrollingFrame.HorizontalScrollBarInset and ScrollingFrame.VerticalScrollBarInset to indicate whether the canvas should be inset by ScrollBarThickness for the respective scroll bar.

descriptions.before: The ScrollingFrame will never be insetted for this scrolling bar.
descriptions.after: The canvas will never be inset for the respective scroll bar.

descriptions.before: The ScrollingFrame will only be insetted if this scrollbar is being shown.
descriptions.after: The canvas will only be inset if the respective scroll bar is showing.

descriptions.before: The ScrollingFrame will always be insetted regardless if the scrollbar is being shown or not.
descriptions.after: The canvas will always be inset for the respective scroll bar, regardless of whether that scroll bar is showing.

descriptions.before: This enum is used by ScrollingFrame.ScrollingDirection to specify the direction scrolling is allowed.
descriptions.after: This enum is used by ScrollingFrame.ScrollingDirection to specify the direction(s) in which scrolling is allowed.

descriptions.before: Canvas can only be scrolled along the X axis.
descriptions.after: The canvas can only be scrolled along the X axis.

descriptions.before: Canvas can only be scrolled along the Y axis.
descriptions.after: The canvas can only be scrolled along the Y axis.

descriptions.before: Canvas can be scrolled along both X and Y axes.
descriptions.after: The canvas can be scrolled along both the X and Y axes.

descriptions.before: Indicates the side that the vertical scrollbar will be located at.
descriptions.after: This enum is used for ScrollingFrame.VerticalScrollBarPosition to indicate vertical scroll bar positioning.
